commands.command: grep -q Demo configs/demo/company.md && grep -q 2024 configs/demo/company.md && grep -q 2025 configs/demo/company.md

v=$(python3 -I -c 'import csv; print([r["value"] for r in csv.DictReader(open("configs/demo/data/esg-2025.csv")) if r["key"]=="employees_total"][0])') && test -n "$v" && grep -qF "$v" configs/demo/company.md
for f in configs/demo/sections/verbatim/env-policy.txt configs/demo/sections/verbatim/social-policy.txt; do test -s $f && head -1 $f | grep -qv '^#' || exit 1; done

python3 -I -c '
import re
d = open("configs/demo/mappings-demo.yaml").read()
s = open("configs/demo/mappings-sandbox.example.yaml").read()
for f in ("configs/demo/sections/esg-environmental.yaml", "configs/demo/sections/esg-social.yaml"):
    y = open(f).read()
    names = re.findall(r"(?:source|target|prior): *\"?((?:src|rpt)_[a-z0-9_]+)", y)
    assert len(names) >= 36, f
    for n in names:
        assert re.search(r"name: *%s\b" % n, d), ("demo", n)
        assert re.search(r"name: *%s\b" % n, s), ("sandbox", n)
assert all(re.fullmatch(r"\"?demo-esg-[a-z0-9-]+\"?", i) for i in re.findall(r"^ *-? *id: *(\S+)", d, re.M))
'

mkdir -p .scratch/l4-smoke && rm -f .scratch/l4-smoke/* && go build -o .scratch/l4-smoke/mcp ./cmd/workiva-mcp && (NL_DEMO_MODE=true NL_DEMO_PIPELINE=true NL_DEMO_SECTIONS_DIR=configs/demo/sections NL_DB_PATH=.scratch/l4-smoke/demo.db NL_API_KEY=smoke NL_LISTEN_ADDR=127.0.0.1:0 timeout 20 .scratch/l4-smoke/mcp -mappings configs/demo/mappings-demo.yaml > .scratch/l4-smoke/log 2>&1; true) && grep -q 'loaded extra mappings from configs/demo/mappings-demo.yaml' .scratch/l4-smoke/log && grep -q 'demo pipeline enabled' .scratch/l4-smoke/log
